title: Purification, characterization, and protective effects against oxidative injury of peptides prepared by enzymatic hydrolysis from Polygala crotalarioides.
authors: Huang, Jiamin; Liu, Jing; Yang, Zhihao; Zhang, Xianwei; He, Yongsheng; Zhang, Yongmin; Zhu, Zhenyuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究远志蛋白水解肽的抗氧化活性及细胞保护作用，涉及分子对接但对象为肽-蛋白通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: In this study, Polygala crotalarioides, a traditional Chinese medicinal herb, was investigated. Proteins were extracted and hydrolyzed to obtain peptides with high antioxidant activity. The results showed that, compared with the unhydrolyzed protein, the soluble fraction after enzymatic hydrolysis exhibited a significant increase in DPPH radical scavenging activity from 21.7% to 76.2%, accompanied by changes in the relative content of amino acids. The purified peptide fraction markedly alleviated H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative damage in PC12 cells. Compared with the model group, this fraction reduced LDH release and MDA levels to 64.4% and 56.1%, respectively, while restoring SOD activity from 45.3% to 79.1%, indicating that its protective effect is mediated by the enhancement of endogenous antioxidant capacity. Combining LC-MS/MS analysis with molecular docking, three novel bioactive peptide sequences were identified, among which WGFLF was selected for cellular validation. At a concentration of 1.6 mg/mL, WGFLF increased the viability of H(2)O(2)-damaged PC12 cells from 48.6% to 83.24%. Further RT-qPCR analysis revealed that this peptide exerts cytoprotective effects against oxidative stress through modulation of the Keap1-Nrf2 signaling pathway. This study provides important theoretical support for the development of Polygala crotalarioides.
abstract_zh: 本研究以传统中药材远志（Polygala crotalarioides）为对象，提取蛋白质并水解获得具有高抗氧化活性的多肽。结果表明，与未水解蛋白相比，酶解后的可溶性组分对DPPH自由基清除活性从21.7%显著提高至76.2%，同时伴随氨基酸相对含量的变化。纯化后的多肽组分显著缓解了H(2)O(2)诱导的PC12细胞氧化损伤。与模型组相比，该组分将LDH释放量和MDA水平分别降低至64.4%和56.1%，同时将SOD活性从45.3%恢复至79.1%，表明其保护作用通过增强内源性抗氧化能力介导。结合LC-MS/MS分析和分子对接，鉴定出三种新型生物活性肽序列，其中WGFLF被选作细胞验证。在1.6 mg/mL浓度下，WGFLF将H(2)O(2)损伤的PC12细胞活力从48.6%提高至83.24%。进一步的RT-qPCR分析揭示，该肽通过调节Keap1-Nrf2信号通路发挥对氧化应激的细胞保护作用。本研究为远志的开发提供了重要的理论支持。
